title: Measurements
description: Pick a device, then one or more of its series. Device/series lists come from the StarRocks view measurements.device_series (refreshed every 10 min); the panels read measurements.series_values, which only scans the tables of the selected series.

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device AS __text, device_id AS __value FROM measurements.device_series ORDER BY device
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT device AS __text, device_id AS __value FROM measurements.device_series ORDER BY device

list.name: series
list.label: Series
list.query: SELECT metric FROM measurements.device_series WHERE device_id = '${device:raw}' ORDER BY metric
list.definition: SELECT metric FROM measurements.device_series WHERE device_id = '${device:raw}' ORDER BY metric

panels.title: Selected series
panels.description: All selected series on one axis. Series with different scales: see the per-series charts below.

targets.rawSql:
SET VARIABLE series_query = (SELECT string_agg(sql, ' UNION ALL ') FROM measurements.series_sql
                             WHERE metric IN (${series:sqlstring}));
SELECT time_bucket(to_milliseconds($__interval_ms), time) AS time,
       CASE WHEN unit IS NULL OR unit = '' THEN metric ELSE CONCAT(metric, ' (', unit, ')') END AS metric,
       AVG(value) AS value
FROM query(getvariable('series_query'))
WHERE source = '${device:raw}'
  AND metric IN (${series:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SET VARIABLE series_query = (SELECT string_agg(sql, ' UNION ALL ') FROM measurements.series_sql
                             WHERE metric IN (${series:sqlstring}));
SELECT metric AS "Series", MAX(unit) AS "Unit",
       MAX_BY(value, time) AS "Latest", MIN(value) AS "Min",
       AVG(value) AS "Average", MAX(value) AS "Max",
       COUNT(*) AS "Measurements"
FROM query(getvariable('series_query'))
WHERE source = '${device:raw}'
  AND metric IN (${series:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY metric
ORDER BY metric

SET VARIABLE series_query = (SELECT string_agg(sql, ' UNION ALL ') FROM measurements.series_sql
                             WHERE metric IN (${series:sqlstring}));
SELECT time AS "Time", metric AS "Series", value AS "Value", unit AS "Unit"
FROM query(getvariable('series_query'))
WHERE source = '${device:raw}'
  AND metric IN (${series:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT metric AS "Series", unit AS "Unit", measurements AS "Measurements",
       first_time AS "First", last_time AS "Last"
FROM measurements.device_series
WHERE device_id = '${device:raw}'
ORDER BY metric

SET VARIABLE series_query = (SELECT string_agg(sql, ' UNION ALL ') FROM measurements.series_sql
                             WHERE metric IN (${series:sqlstring}));
SELECT time_bucket(to_milliseconds($__interval_ms), time) AS time,
       CASE WHEN unit IS NULL OR unit = '' THEN metric ELSE CONCAT(metric, ' (', unit, ')') END AS metric,
       AVG(value) AS value
FROM query(getvariable('series_query'))
WHERE source = '${device:raw}'
  AND metric IN (${series:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
